post.description:
Submit a credit score request.

1. Validates input and checks idempotency
2. Runs hard-stop pre-screening rules (Section 5.2)
3. If hard-stop triggers → immediate DECLINE
4. Otherwise → saves as PROCESSING, publishes to DE, returns async response

Use the `Idempotency-Key` header to prevent duplicate requests.

post.description:
Submit a batch scoring job.

Persists a BulkScoringJob record and publishes the job to the
batch-score-request Service Bus topic. The orchestrator picks it up
asynchronously and writes progress to blob storage.

get.description: List all batch jobs for the authenticated organization.

Return status and live progress for a batch job.

While the job is in_progress, the orchestrator keeps
model-artifacts/batch/{job_id}/status.json updated.
This endpoint merges that blob data with our DB record.

Return paginated scoring results for a completed batch job.

Results are only available once ingestion_status == "complete".
While ingestion is running, the response will indicate the current
ingested_count so the frontend can show a progress state.

post.description:
Cancel a queued batch job.

Only possible while status is 'queued' — once the orchestrator has
started processing, cancellation is no longer available.

BureauFeatures.title: BureauFeatures
BureauFeatures.description:
All 30 features as defined in the DE contract.

Types are matched to the XDS source data so values roundtrip cleanly
through the reverse mapper:
  • str  – direct passthrough from a single XDS field (same format)
  • int  – computed counts, binary flags, derived values
  • float – computed ratios
See docs/de_feature_mapping.md for the full XDS → feature mapping.
